visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a man and a woman sitting on a wooden bench against a light green textured wall. The man on the left has a shaved head and wears a patterned denim jacket with blue and pink tones, while the woman on the right has long dark hair and wears a deep blue oversized hoodie. They are looking directly at the camera with neutral but friendly expressions. (2) The woman brings her hands toward the camera lens, holding a small black rectangular action camera close to the viewer's perspective. Behind her, the man smiles, partially obscured by the device. The background remains the same textured wall, but the focus shifts to the small camera held in the center of the frame. (3) A series of rapid cuts show a person's hand attaching the tiny camera to various surfaces: a metallic pole outdoors, a yellow overhead handle inside a train, and a white metal staircase railing. The hands have gold rings on the fingers. The scenes shift from a bright outdoor environment to a brightly lit train interior. (4) The footage shifts to multiple POV shots including a group of friends sitting on a stone ledge in a European-style plaza under a clear blue sky, a couple sitting inside a glass cable car overlooking a city, and a man spinning a small child around in a park with green trees. The camera is then shown magnetically attached to the man's patterned shirt at chest level. (5) An older woman with short hair and sunglasses holds the camera while wearing a yellow and white vest. The camera is then attached to a black leather backpack worn by a man walking across a pedestrian crossing. Indoor shots follow, showing a POV from inside a refrigerator and a microwave as objects are moved. (6) A hand holds various camera accessories, including a small tripod stand and a suction cup mount on a car window. A woman drinks from a glass while wearing the camera clipped to her hat, showing an extreme close-up of her eyes. Two people are then seen playing tennis on a blue indoor court, with the camera clipped to the net. (7) A sequence of still photos appears, showing the couple and their children in various settings like a train and a station platform, looking happy and posing. (8) The video returns to the original couple on the bench. The woman holds the camera and speaks while the man gestures towards it and eventually puts his arm around her, smiling. (9) A final scene shows a POV from inside a shopping cart filled with strawberries, looking up at a small child who is pushing the cart through a supermarket aisle with shelves of products in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-pitched female voice saying 'Hellooooo' accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop beat with clear synthesizer chords and a driving percussion line. A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the first second. (2) A subtle 'pop' sound effect triggers as variety-style text appears on screen. The music continues with a consistent rhythmic pulse while the female speaker's tone remains highly energetic and friendly, speaking in Mandarin with occasional English words. (3) A mechanical 'click' or camera shutter sound effect marks the transition as the camera is revealed. The BGM maintains its tempo, but a rhythmic filter sweep is audible. (4) A rapid succession of 'whoosh' and 'snap' sound effects occurs every second as the visuals montage through different camera mounting positions. The music's bass kick becomes more pronounced to drive the pacing. (5) A distinct 'ding' sound occurs as a transition effect, followed by the female narrator's voice laughing slightly. The BGM remains dominant in the background but ducks slightly when the speaker emphasizes specific features. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transitions the audio into the sports sequence, where the sound of tennis rackets hitting balls is synthesized as part of the rhythmic edit. (7) The music reaches a bridge section with slightly less harmonic density as the photo montage plays, though the beat remains steady. (8) The female voice returns to a conversational level in the outro, ending with a male voice briefly saying 'I approved' with a confident, mid-range pitch. (9) The final phase features a rhythmic 'pop' sound effect and the BGM fading out as a child's playful babbling is heard faintly in the background.
